from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class DocumentData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document relevant to filtering by crime category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the document as it appears in the case file")
    doc_type: str = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书，通知书)")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The general nature of the case (e.g., 刑事，民事，行政)")
    criminal_charges: List[str] = Field(description="List of specific criminal charges or crimes mentioned in the document")
    stated_cause: Optional[str] = Field(description="The formal case cause (案由) explicitly stated in the document, if any")
    legal_category: Optional[str] = Field(description="Any specific legal chapter or broader category mentioned (e.g., 刑法第六章 妨害社会管理秩序罪)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentData]
